body: Chief on P0-3 candidate 87c6ca2: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — merge after one small fix. Independent evidence: archive export at 87c6ca2, clean pin — align 86/86, laws 67/67, fixtures 87/87; fresh-context re-review confirmed every block item at file:line, and from outside align the original transplant probe and a new flow-topology forgery (exact marginals, step 0 joining rows 0 and 2) are both rejected; new/apply/of/faithfulOnly/copy on Admissibility all fail with 'cannot be accessed'. REQUIRED (doc): the type proves gate admission, not inference provenance — a caller can place faithful mass on a non-contradicted non-candidate; state that residual in the HsmmResult Scaladoc (hsmm.scala:119-133), and file a follow-up bead 'candidates as part of the proof' to be designed together with the codec decode path (it would need Candidates at decode). Nits, no action needed now: infer runs ModeGate twice per (unit, candidate); costs need not cover admissible states; logLikelihood ±Inf passes. Then: merge onto main (align/laws/fixtures paths only; cost.scala's three private[align] modifiers — coordinate with Codex-root's live cost.scala hold: it lands first or you rebase, as you said), post the merge SHA, I ack, you push.
